name: eUPF
what_it_is: eUPF is an open-source 5G User Plane Function (UPF) that uses eBPF XDP hooks for high-performance packet forwarding between the 5G core and data networks. It separates into a userspace control plane (PFCP session management) and an in-kernel forwarding plane (XDP-based PDR/FAR/QER processing), and has been validated with Free5GC, Open5GS, and OpenAirInterface.
components: eupf (UPF binary — control plane + eBPF forwarding plane)
PFCP server (default :8805) — N4 interface to SMF
eBPF XDP hook — attached per network interface for packet processing
protocols: GTP-U (N3 — gNB↔UPF encapsulation, N9 — I-UPF/A-UPF chaining)
IPv4 (data plane; IPv6 counted but not forwarded as of current release)
GTP Echo (path management toward neighbour GTP nodes)
measurement: upf_pfcp_rx_errors — PFCP messages with cause code
upf_xdp_aborted / upf_xdp_drop / upf_xdp_pass / upf_xdp_tx / upf_xdp_redirect — XDP action counters
upf_rx_arp / upf_rx_icmp / upf_rx_ip4 / upf_rx_ip6 / upf_rx_tcp / upf_rx_udp / upf_rx_other — per-protocol RX counters
upf_rx_gtp_echo / upf_rx_gtp_pdu / upf_rx_gtp_other / upf_rx_gtp_error — GTP RX counters
upf_pfcp_sessions — current active PFCP sessions gauge
configuration: UPF_INTERFACE_NAME — list of N3/N6 interfaces for XDP attachment (mandatory)
UPF_N3_ADDRESS — IPv4 address of N3 interface (mandatory)
UPF_N9_ADDRESS — IPv4 address of N9 interface (optional, defaults to N3 address)
UPF_PFCP_NODE_ID — local NodeID for PFCP (IPv4 format, default: 127.0.0.1)
UPF_MAX_SESSIONS — max sessions; auto-sizes eBPF maps (PDR=2×, FAR=PDR, QER=1×, URR=3×); default 65535
UPF_QER_MAP_SIZE / UPF_FAR_MAP_SIZE / UPF_PDR_MAP_SIZE / UPF_URR_MAP_SIZE — override individual eBPF map sizes
UPF_FEATURE_UEIP — enable UE IP address allocation (default: false)
UPF_FEATURE_FTUP — enable F-TEID allocation in UP function (default: false)
UPF_UEIP_POOL — UE IP pool CIDR when UEIP enabled (default: 10.60.0.0/24)
UPF_TEID_POOL — TEID pool size when FTUP enabled (default: 65535)
UPF_GTP_PEER — list of GTP peer addresses for echo requests
UPF_ECHO_INTERVAL — GTP echo interval in seconds (default: 10)
Config accepted via YAML file, environment variables, or CLI flags (Viper precedence: CLI > env > file > default)
fault_injection: No built-in fault injection primitives documented in the repository
XDP drop/abort counters (upf_xdp_drop, upf_xdp_aborted) are observable but not controllable via API
Packet loss can be induced externally via tc/iptables rules on the host interfaces attached by XDP
PFCP error responses observable via upf_pfcp_rx_errors with cause codes (see PfcpCauseCodes.md)
modes: Standalone — single eupf container with default loopback interface (quick-start/demo)
Integrated with Open5GS — eupf replaces open5gs-upfd, SMF connects via PFCP
Integrated with Free5GC — free5gc-compose variant available in docs/deployments/free5gc-ulcl
Integrated with OpenAirInterface — oai compose variant available in docs/deployments/oai
I-UPF/A-UPF ULCL/Branching mode — N9 interface for uplink classifier and anchor UPF chaining
XDP generic mode — kernel-level, any NIC, lower performance (default/evaluation)
XDP native mode — driver-level, requires driver support, higher performance
XDP offload mode — NIC-level execution, requires NIC support
constraints: Requires Linux kernel >= 5.15.0-25-generic; earlier kernels not supported
Requires privileged container (NET_ADMIN + SYS_ADMIN capabilities) to load eBPF objects and set rlimits
eBPF filesystem must be mounted at /sys/fs/bpf on the host for persistence across restarts
Currently only IPv4 NodeID is supported for PFCP
Only one FAR rule per PDR is supported
Only one QER rule per PDR is supported
Only one SDF filter per GTP tunnel is supported
XDP generic mode only is fully validated; native/offload depend on NIC driver support
Kernel FIB lookup used for routing; unresolvable routes fall back to kernel (performance penalty)
No built-in monitoring/debugging via tcpdump or CLI (listed as not-yet-implemented in roadmap)
docker_services: eupf — ghcr.io/edgecomllc/eupf:main (or versioned tag), privileged, mounts /sys/fs/bpf
mongodb — mongo:5.0.10-focal, subscriber database for Open5GS
amf — gradiant/open5gs:2.7.2, access and mobility management
smf — gradiant/open5gs:2.7.2, session management (controls eupf via PFCP)
pcf / udm / udr / bsf / nssf — gradiant/open5gs:2.7.2, policy/data management functions
nat — wbitt/network-multitool:alpine-minimal, NAT/masquerade for N6 traffic
populate — gradiant/open5gs-dbctl:0.10.3, seeds subscriber records into MongoDB
notable_absences: No tcpdump or CLI-based debugging built in (roadmap item, not yet implemented)
No IPv6 data-plane forwarding (IPv6 packets counted but not routed)
No multi-SMF set support (SSET / MPAS features not implemented)
No per-QoS-flow or per-GTP-path QoS monitoring (QFQM / GPQM not implemented)
No RTT measurement toward UE without PMF (RTTWP not implemented)
No built-in traffic generation or load-testing tooling in the main image
Helm chart and Grafana dashboards available under .deploy/ but no pre-wired observability stack in the basic compose
